caption: The video captures an arid desert plain beneath a low, heavy storm cloud deck, with a flat horizon, a small mesa at left, and scattered shrubs fixed throughout. A bright rain shaft hangs on the right side of the frame, and a dark finger of cloud protrudes downward from the central cloud base. The clouds continuously churn and deform, their undersides undulating and reorganizing from frame to frame. The bright gap in the upper sky shifts shape and brightness, while small blue patches appear and fade within it. The central lowering, already present at the start, elongates and thickens through the early and middle frames, then persists as a hanging mass creeping slowly rightward. The rain shaft remains visible the whole time, its column edges widening and contracting as the cloud system moves across the sky. No visible motion touches the desert floor, so the movement appears confined to the churning clouds and precipitation. The lowering remains suspended beneath the rolling deck while the rain shaft continues falling at right.
relations: The churning cloud deck causes the central lowering to elongate and creep rightward while suspended.
The moving cloud system keeps the right rain shaft visible, its edges widening and contracting.
The shifting upper sky gap allows small blue patches to appear and fade.
The fixed desert floor remains untouched by motion while clouds churn above.
